latest_release.name: Strata 0.2.13
latest_release.body:
# Strata 0.2.13: new DFlash2 defaults per card, a faster app start, a fix for the Strix Halo Terminal launch, and Qwen4 groundwork

The app and the Terminal are 0.2.13. Control and every engine package are 0.1.59. The update feed is sequence 124 (the DGX Spark feed stays 123).
The DGX Spark (linux-aarch64) gets 0.2.13 too.

## 0.2.13.1 (11-09): Intel Arc fix for the Linux app

Control 0.1.59.1 lets the desktop app set up a model on an Intel Arc card. Before, setup stopped with "no NVIDIA GPU found". To get it, press Update on the Strata row in Settings > Updates, or run `strata update` in the Terminal, then start the app again. The app can't download models for an Arc card yet: choose "Use your own GGUF…" and pick the folder with the model's .gguf files. On an Arc A750, Q2_0 was ready in 121 seconds, and a chat ran at 12.6 tokens per second. Windows, Mac and the DGX Spark have nothing to update.

**Windows and Mac, Terminal still on 0.2.12:** `strata update` updates the engine to 0.1.59 and keeps the Terminal at 0.2.12; it says "Control not part of this feed". On an RTX 5070, Gyro-S was ready in 114.7 seconds after this update and 3 chats passed. The Terminal moves on with the next release. The app is not affected.

## Highlights

- **DFlash2 drafting, new defaults per card:** Strix Halo, UD-Q4_K_XL, 46.6 to 49.1 tokens per second (+5.2%). RTX PRO 5000 72 GB, IQ3_S, 256-261 to 263-265 (+2.8%).
- **Strix Halo (Windows):** the Terminal launch of UD-Q4_K_XL with pictures off starts. Setup writes a 700 MB reserve, and the engine no longer applies its 2,560 MiB Windows floor on integrated graphics.
- **Intel Arc:** the same prompt gives the same answer on every run. 50 of 50 runs were identical on an A750, against 3 to 5 different answers in 5 runs before.
- **App start:** the main file went from 3.12 MB to 0.76 MB, and the start screen from 248.5 ms to 143.4 ms (headless Chrome, median of 10).
- **Linux:** the expert store loads again when free memory, the file cache or a reserved huge-page pool can hold it (#5327, PR #5531 by pjgmobile).
- **Qwen4 groundwork:** the signed update feed can carry a model list, and a model of a new shape gets its own engine download beside the Strata engine.

## Speed against 0.2.12

Tokens per second, 0.2.12 to 0.2.13, on the DFlash2 defaults that changed. Other machines and models were not measured again.

| Machine, model | Output | Output text |
|---|---|---|
| Strix Halo, UD-Q4_K_XL | 46.6 to 49.1 (+5.2%) | differs from 0.2.12 on 30 of 36 prompts, the same on every run |
| Strix Halo, UD-IQ4_XS-v31 | +2.0% | identical |
| RTX PRO 5000 72 GB, IQ3_S | 256-261 to 263-265 (+2.8%) | identical |

How it was measured: the 0.2.12 settings and the 0.2.13 settings side by side through the Terminal's own flags, 3 interleaved rounds, a fresh engine start per run, greedy answers of 300 tokens. Speeds were not measured again on the final 0.1.59 packages.

## What changed for you

- **DFlash2 window and confidence per card.** Strix Halo: window 5 to 8. Blackwell cc 12.0 with 48 GB or more (the RTX PRO 5000 72 GB class): window 6 to 8, and confidence 0.35 to 0.55 for IQ3_S. The DGX Spark and other cards keep their 0.2.12 values.
- **The app's Load fetches the tuned DFlash2 drafter by itself when Auto picks it** (as on the RTX PRO 5000 72 GB), as the Terminal does. On an RTX PRO 5000 with IQ3_S (3 rounds of 12 prompts per kind): agent +10.1%, chat +4.8%, all +6.1%, output identical 72 of 72.
- **Windows RX 9070 / R9700 (gfx1201) and RX 7900 (gfx1100):** the hipBLASLt table is no longer used by default. This restores the 10-19 rule of gfx1151 only, which the engine had overridden since 0.2.10. `STRATA_HIPBLASLT_TABLE=on` uses the table.
- **Settings the launcher used to write are now the engine's own defaults,** so a plain engine start matches the app and the Terminal: the parallel stack on Linux CUDA with 2 or more slots, the GDN settings on Linux CUDA, the chunked GDN scan on Linux with all cards gfx12, the gfx
